The '''Alien Outreach Center''' was a small enclave in the [[High Security Lockdown]] sector of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Inhabited by [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], it also served as a recon outpost for agents of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. The [[Evocii]] [[Enaq]] and [[Darthyn]] worked at the center, and [[Kira Carsen]] lived at the center for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] until she was forced to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Ur'kossags]] gang after they threatened her friends and tried to forcibly recruit her.
